message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t determine a winner with the information you’ve given.

In Texas Hold’em each player is dealt two “hole” cards, and then five community cards are revealed (the flop, turn, and river). A player’s best possible five‑card hand is made from any combination of those seven cards.  

Because you only supplied the two hole cards for each player and no community cards, there’s no way to evaluate the final hands or decide who would win. If you can provide the community cards (or at least the final five‑card hands), I’ll be happy to tell you who comes out on top.
